items.title: How publishers can prepare their content for AI monetization on AWS
items.summary: AI systems are consuming publishers’ content on a massive scale while traditional web traffic search referrals decline. This pattern is accelerating as AI systems shift from a crawl-and-refer model to a crawl-and-consume model. Traditional search engines sent web traffic back to publishers. Large language models (LLMs) synthesize publishers’ content without attribution or referral. The decision […]
